news.titleEn: Nasdaq falls more than 2% for worst day since June as AI spending woes, oil prices spark sell-off: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.6% and the S&P 500 lost 1.2% on Thursday as AI capex fears hit chip stocks and surging oil added inflation worries.
news.conclusionZh: AI支出担忧叠加油价飙升，纳指跌2.6%创6月来最差单日
news.whyEn: AI-linked tech stocks have powered most of this bull market, so doubts about AI spending returns threaten the broader index and investors' retirement portfolios.
news.whyZh: AI科技股是本轮牛市主引擎，其回报遭质疑会拖累整体市场
news.detailEn: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 6.7%, its biggest drop since June, with AMD down more than 8%, Micron 6% and Nvidia 4%. Meta fell about 7% despite beating estimates, after reporting heavy AI spending. At the same time Brent crude jumped above $110 on Middle East escalation, reviving inflation concerns. The combination of disappointing AI-era earnings and an energy shock created a risk-off mood that spilled into Asian markets on Friday.
news.detailZh: 费城半导体指数暴跌6.7%，为6月以来最大跌幅，AMD跌超8%，美光跌6%，英伟达跌4%。Meta业绩虽超预期，但因AI支出庞大股价仍跌约7%。与此同时，中东局势升级令布伦特原油突破110美元，再度引发通胀担忧。AI财报不及预期与能源冲击叠加，避险情绪周五蔓延至亚洲市场。

news.titleEn: Brent at 5 month high on escalating Middle East conflict
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude climbed to around $112 a barrel, its highest since May, after more Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Iranian claims of strikes on tankers near the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞袭沙、霍尔木兹油轮遇袭，布油升至5个月高点约112美元
news.whyEn: Oil above $110 raises fuel, transport and airfare costs worldwide and makes it harder for central banks to cut rates.
news.whyZh: 油价破110美元推高全球燃油与运输成本，央行降息更难
news.detailEn: Brent rose more than $3 to about $112 a barrel, touching its highest level since May 18. Iran's Revolutionary Guards said four vessels doing ship-to-ship oil transfers were hit and set ablaze, while three more struck mines west of the Strait of Hormuz. Houthi drones and missiles also targeted Saudi airports and oil infrastructure. Analysts expect little de-escalation before the November 3 US midterms, keeping prices elevated.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油上涨逾3美元至约112美元，触及5月18日以来最高。伊朗革命卫队称，4艘在海上过驳石油的船只被击中起火，另有3艘在霍尔木兹海峡以西触雷。胡塞武装还用无人机和导弹袭击了沙特机场和石油设施。分析师预计11月3日美国中期选举前局势难以降温，油价将维持高位。

news.titleEn: U.S. Reportedly Considering Major Strikes on Iran After Midterms
news.conclusionEn: The US and Israel have reportedly drawn up plans for a short but intense round of strikes on Iran that could begin after the November 3 midterm elections.
news.conclusionZh: 据报美以已拟定中期选举后对伊朗发动短促猛烈打击计划
news.whyEn: Renewed strikes on Iran's energy and nuclear sites could send oil sharply higher again and upend global markets.
news.whyZh: 若再打击伊朗能源与核设施，油价可能再度飙升冲击全球市场
news.detailEn: Citing a New York Times report, planners are weighing a roughly three-day campaign against Iranian nuclear facilities, energy infrastructure and missile and drone capabilities. The Pentagon is still building up forces, including three aircraft carriers, with deployment expected to finish in early November. President Trump has not approved new strikes while diplomatic talks continue, and has pledged not to attack before the election. Treasury yields fell and safe-haven demand rose after the report.
news.detailZh: 据《纽约时报》报道，军方正考虑对伊朗核设施、能源基础设施及导弹无人机能力发动约三天的集中打击。五角大楼仍在增兵，包括三艘航母，预计11月初完成部署。在外交谈判持续期间，特朗普尚未批准新的打击，并承诺选举前不会动手。报道发布后美债收益率下跌，避险需求上升。

news.titleEn: Meta is creating non-voting stock it could use to fund AI spending
news.conclusionEn: Meta beat Q3 estimates with $64.6 billion in revenue but posted negative free cash flow and announced a new non-voting Class C share to help fund its AI buildout.
news.conclusionZh: Meta营收超预期但现金流转负，将发无投票权股为AI融资
news.whyEn: It shows even the richest tech giants now need outside capital for AI, while Zuckerberg keeps full control.
news.whyZh: 连最赚钱的科技巨头也需外部资金支撑AI，且扎克伯格控制权不变
news.detailEn: Meta raised the low end of its 2026 capex guidance to $135-145 billion, and quarterly free cash flow swung to an outflow of about $2.1 billion from a $10.6 billion inflow a year earlier. It plans to issue one Class C share per existing share, effectively a 2-for-1 split, taking effect in January. The new shares can be used to raise capital, pay staff and fund acquisitions without diluting voting control. The stock fell about 7% as investors questioned the payoff of AI spending.
news.detailZh: Meta将2026年资本开支指引下限上调至1350亿-1450亿美元，季度自由现金流由去年同期流入106亿美元转为流出约21亿美元。公司计划每股派发一股C类股，相当于1拆2，明年1月生效。新股可用于融资、员工薪酬和收购，且不稀释投票控制权。由于投资者质疑AI投入回报，股价下跌约7%。

news.titleEn: China's stock market sinks into bear territory as CSI 300 extends 10-week rout
news.conclusionEn: China's CSI 300 fell 1.8% to 4,036 on Thursday, more than 20% below its June peak, entering its first bear market since 2020.
news.conclusionZh: 沪深300跌1.8%，较6月高点跌超20%进入技术性熊市
news.whyEn: A bear market in China's blue chips signals fading stimulus hopes and weighs on global investors and Asian markets.
news.whyZh: 中国蓝筹进入熊市反映刺激预期减退，拖累亚洲及全球投资者
news.detailEn: The index has fallen for nearly ten straight weeks, closing at its lowest since July 2025. Tech, semiconductor and AI shares led the losses amid worries about the global AI trade. Bloomberg also cited weak earnings and fading hopes for more stimulus. South Korea's KOSPI, Japan's Nikkei and Taiwan's TAIEX also fell, pointing to region-wide weakness.
news.detailZh: 该指数已接近连续十周下跌，收于2025年7月以来最低。科技、半导体和AI股领跌，市场担忧全球AI交易降温。彭博社还指出盈利疲弱、刺激预期减退等因素。韩国KOSPI、日经225和台湾加权指数同步下跌，显示区域性走弱。

news.titleEn: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
news.conclusionEn: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek has reportedly raised about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion), led by CATL and Tencent, just days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its technology.
news.conclusionZh: DeepSeek获宁德时代、腾讯领投约150亿美元融资
news.whyEn: It is China's largest private financing this year and shows Beijing's tech champions are doubling down on AI despite US pressure.
news.whyZh: 为今年中国最大一级市场融资，显示中国在美压力下加码AI
news.detailEn: DeepSeek reportedly raised its target at least twice, from 50 billion yuan to around 100 billion yuan. New backers include Midea, Meituan, Geely and GigaDevice. The money will go to model research and computing power as the company prepares a restructuring and a possible IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market. The raise came two days after Washington ordered federal agencies to purge DeepSeek's AI over security concerns.
news.detailZh: 据报DeepSeek至少两次上调融资目标，从500亿元增至约1000亿元。美的、美团、吉利和兆易创新成为新股东。资金将用于模型研发和算力，公司正筹备重组并可能在上交所科创板IPO。此次融资发生在美国以安全为由命令联邦机构移除DeepSeek技术两天之后。

news.titleEn: Barclays to slash 5,000 jobs in AI efficiency push
news.conclusionEn: Barclays will cut about 5,000 jobs, roughly 5% of its workforce, as it uses AI to reduce costs, while Q3 pre-tax profit rose 12% to £2.3 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 巴克莱借AI降本裁员约5000人，三季度税前利润增12%
news.whyEn: It is one of the clearest examples yet of a major bank directly replacing roles with AI, a signal for white-collar workers across finance.
news.whyZh: 大型银行用AI直接替代岗位的典型案例，对金融白领是明确信号
news.detailEn: About 1,000 roles were cut in the first half of 2026, with the rest spread over the second half. Around 60% of the cuts fall in support functions, including developers. Fixed-income and currency trading revenue fell 19% to £1.01 billion, a sharper drop than at major US rivals. CEO C.S. Venkatakrishnan is leaning on AI to hit cost and return targets.
news.detailZh: 2026年上半年已裁减约1000个岗位，其余在下半年完成。约60%的裁员集中在包括开发人员在内的支持部门。固定收益和外汇交易收入下降19%至10.1亿英镑，降幅大于美国主要同行。CEO文卡塔克里希南正依靠AI实现成本和回报目标。

news.titleEn: American Airlines Forecasts 2026 Loss as Fuel Costs Outpace Fare Gains
news.conclusionEn: American Airlines now expects an adjusted 2026 loss of $1.00 to $1.60 a share, abandoning a range that allowed for a profit, as jet fuel costs soar.
news.conclusionZh: 燃油成本飙升，美国航空预计2026年全年亏损
news.whyEn: It shows how the oil shock from the Iran war is squeezing airlines despite record revenue, likely meaning higher fares for travelers.
news.whyZh: 伊朗战争引发的油价冲击挤压航企利润，机票或继续上涨
news.detailEn: American posted record third-quarter revenue of $16.34 billion, led by premium cabins and corporate travel. But it expects to pay about $4.70 a gallon for fuel in the fourth quarter, nearly double a year earlier. Fare increases since the Iran war began have failed to keep pace. Shares fell around 4%, dragging Delta and United lower too.
news.detailZh: 美国航空三季度营收创纪录达163.4亿美元，主要受高端舱位和商务出行带动。但公司预计四季度燃油价格约每加仑4.70美元，几乎是去年同期的两倍。伊朗战争以来的票价上涨未能跟上成本增幅。股价下跌约4%，并拖累达美和美联航下跌。

news.titleEn: Houthi strike kills one and injures eight at King Fahd International Airport
news.conclusionEn: A Houthi drone and missile attack hit King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia's eastern oil hub, killing at least one person and injuring eight.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特达曼法赫德国王机场造成伤亡
news.whyEn: Attacks near the heart of Saudi oil operations raise risks to global energy supply and prompted the US to order nonessential staff out.
news.whyZh: 袭击逼近沙特石油核心区，威胁全球能源供应，美国已撤离非必要人员
news.detailEn: The airport in Dammam lies near Dhahran, home of Saudi Aramco, which reportedly evacuated its headquarters amid escalating attacks. The Houthis said they also targeted Riyadh, Yanbu and Abha airports over 48 hours. The US State Department ordered nonessential government personnel and families to leave Saudi Arabia. Flights later resumed, but the escalation is a key driver of the oil price spike.
news.detailZh: 达曼机场毗邻沙特阿美总部所在地达兰，据报阿美已因袭击升级撤离总部。胡塞武装称48小时内还袭击了利雅得、延布和艾卜哈机场。美国国务院下令非必要政府人员及家属撤离沙特。航班随后恢复，但局势升级是油价飙升的重要推手。

news.titleEn: WHO warns 'more complex' Ebola outbreak now present in 3 African countries
news.conclusionEn: The WHO said the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak now has active or recent cases in DR Congo, Kenya and Nigeria, calling the situation more complex.
news.conclusionZh: 世卫警告埃博拉疫情扩散至刚果金、肯尼亚和尼日利亚
news.whyEn: Spread to Nigeria, Africa's most populous country, raises the risk of wider transmission through major travel hubs.
news.whyZh: 疫情传入非洲人口最多的尼日利亚，经交通枢纽扩散风险上升
news.detailEn: The outbreak, declared in DR Congo in mid-May, has killed more than 4,000 people there. Nigeria reported its first case this week, and authorities are investigating whether the patient crossed paths with Kenya's first case at a Ugandan airport. Uganda had cases earlier but has been declared Ebola-free. There is no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain, complicating containment.
news.detailZh: 疫情5月中旬在刚果（金）宣布，已在当地造成逾4000人死亡。尼日利亚本周报告首例病例，当局正调查该患者是否在乌干达机场与肯尼亚首例患者有接触。乌干达此前出现病例，现已宣布清零。本迪布焦毒株尚无获批疫苗，增加了防控难度。

businessTips.explanationEn: Jevons Paradox says that when technology makes a resource cheaper or more efficient to use, total consumption of that resource often rises rather than falls. Lower cost per unit unlocks new uses and demand. It is useful for forecasting demand and avoiding the mistake of assuming efficiency automatically means savings.
businessTips.explanationZh: 杰文斯悖论指出：当技术让某种资源的使用更便宜或更高效时，该资源的总消耗往往不降反升。单位成本下降会催生新用途和新需求。它帮助你预测需求，避免误以为效率提升就一定意味着节省。
businessTips.exampleEn: As AI computing gets cheaper per query, companies like Meta are spending more on chips and data centers, not less, because cheaper AI creates far more use cases. A business that automates invoicing may end up processing many more invoices rather than cutting its accounting budget.
businessTips.exampleZh: AI单次计算越来越便宜，但Meta等公司在芯片和数据中心上的支出反而越来越多，因为便宜的AI催生了更多应用场景。一家把开票流程自动化的企业，最后可能处理更多发票，而不是缩减财务预算。

businessTips.explanationEn: A Minimum Viable Audience is the smallest group of people you can serve well enough that they reliably pay and spread the word. Instead of chasing mass reach, you pick a narrow niche whose problems you deeply understand. It lowers marketing costs and makes early revenue far more predictable for side hustles.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行受众是指你能服务好、并且愿意持续付费和口碑传播的最小人群。与其追求大规模曝光，不如选一个你深刻理解其痛点的细分群体。这能降低营销成本，让副业的早期收入更可预测。
businessTips.exampleEn: Rather than a general cleaning-tips channel, someone targets Airbnb hosts managing 2-5 properties and sells turnover checklists and supply templates. A thousand engaged hosts paying $15 a month can sustain a solid side income.
businessTips.exampleZh: 与其做泛泛的清洁技巧账号，不如专门服务管理2-5套房源的Airbnb房东，售卖换房清洁清单和耗材模板。一千位活跃房东每月付15美元，就足以支撑可观的副业收入。

businessTips.explanationEn: A bear market is commonly defined as a decline of 20% or more from a recent peak in a stock index or asset. A 10% drop is called a correction. The threshold is a convention rather than a law, but it often marks a shift in investor sentiment and attracts headlines and fund flows.
businessTips.explanationZh: 熊市通常指股票指数或资产价格较近期高点下跌20%以上，下跌10%则称为「回调」。这一门槛是惯例而非定律，但往往标志着投资者情绪的转变，并引发媒体关注和资金流动。
businessTips.exampleEn: China's CSI 300 entered a bear market on Oct 22 after falling over 20% from its June high. Long-term investors often use bear markets to buy gradually through dollar-cost averaging rather than trying to time the bottom.
businessTips.exampleZh: 10月22日沪深300较6月高点下跌超20%，进入熊市。长期投资者常在熊市中通过定投逐步买入，而不是试图精准抄底。
